claim_one_line: THE COUNT ON THE ROOM, SEALED: on N_45, the degree-45 cover of m003 (the 5-fold cyclic cover of d9.2 along the order-5 character from m003's Z/5 torsion) where room for three first appears ((n(1), n(rho)) = (4, 18), room 5, fixed by sm:B1536's banked rows and Lemma A and read directly), which counts (I(W), I(L2W)) does the frame give at the classes of H^1(N_45; rho) (dimension 23 = 3 + 4 x 5 over the deck group's eigenspaces)? Read at three generic draws in each of 42 subspaces (sm:B1536's Part O cusp strata on N_45 and the deck group's eigenspaces with their interior parts), in route N (Shapiro on m003, p_N) and route R (N_45's presentation: the same class transported at p_N, and its own classes at p_R), and at the pulled-back class (fixed at (0, 0) by the banked rows). Controls K1-K6 hold; a pre-seal int64 overflow in route R's eigenspace projection at p_R was caught by K2 and fixed. Predictions P1-P6 with priors (P4 generation-shaped 20%, P5 three 7%); PROVED if a class reads (-3, -3) in two routes at the same class; NEGATIVE (scoped to the generic classes read) if none is generation-shaped. No count read but the fixed one. 0 of 19.
